name: Belairs
description: Bel-Aires were a white greaser street gang based in the Hermosa and Logan Square neighborhoods of Chicago. The gang evolved from the Central Park Chaplins, who congregated at Monticello Park, becoming the Bel-Airs in the mid-1960s. Their main rivals were the Cortland Stacies. Allied organizations included the Simon City Royals, Insane Popes, Palmer Gaylords, Jousters, and Satan's Disciples.
